name: Cauliflower "Fried Rice" with Chicken, Mushrooms, Carrots & Peanuts
ingredients: 1 ½ lb chicken thighs, boneless skinless
instructions: Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
While the pot heats up, pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Season with salt and pepper.

Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken and peanuts; cook, stirring occasionally, until peanuts are golden brown and chicken is cooked through, 6-7 minutes. Transfer to a plate. (Reserve pot for later use.)

Meanwhile, wash and dry ginger; using a clean cutting board, peel and mince. Place in a small bowl along with stir-fry sauce, water, miso paste, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the sauce and set aside.
Return pot to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add riced cauliflower, mushrooms, and carrots; stir-fry until tender and warmed through, 5-6 minutes.
Return chicken to the pot along with the sauce. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens and chicken is warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide chicken-cauliflower "fried rice" between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
